characters.description: Ken Nagato narrates the series. He is a first-year at Halen whose rare Emperor class comes with a sealed Demon Lord as its secondary class. When the book opens he is level 5, his skills include Absorb, Discharge and Dark Blades, and his party has just defeated its first boss. He leads a group made up of his partners Fayeth, Dez and Charlotte, along with Harley and Charlotte's rabbit, Bun Bun. He has also agreed to help rebuild the Nagato clan of assassins, a life his late mother chose to leave. His grandmother drives the party to the family estate for two weeks of training.
characters.name: Ken Nagato

characters.description: Ken's instructor at Halen and his patron, a very high-level adventurer who is personally invested in how fast he grows. She comes with the party to the Nagato estate and shares a house with Ken during the training stay. She and the elven royal censor dislike each other openly, and Crimson boasts that she once broke the censor's sword. Ken's grandfather flirts with her when she arrives.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: An elf and the tank of Ken's party. She says the city under her people's great tree is home to about twenty million elves. She shares an elven partner bond with Ken, which one of his grandmothers and the elven censor both treat as significant, and she moves into his house at the family estate.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: A half-succubus warlock who scouts and fights at range for Ken's party. She is one of Ken's three partners, along with Fayeth and Charlotte, and she helps keep watch over the demonic seal inside him.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: The druid healer of Ken's party and one of his partners. She is partnered with Bun Bun, a rabbit who fights with the group and understands what people say.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: The bard of Ken's party, and the one member who is not also his partner. On arrival at the Nagato estate, grandmother Yui quietly lines up an especially tough training schedule for her.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: Charlotte's rabbit, who fights with the party. The grandparents tell everyone that he will go through the same hard training as the humans during the stay at the family estate.
characters.name: Bun Bun

characters.description: An elven envoy who serves the elven princess and has been sent to keep an eye on Ken's party. She clashes openly with Crimson and wants to know more about Ken and his team. When Fayeth decides to stay in Ken's house at the estate, the censor goes along with it.
characters.name: The royal censor

characters.description: One of Ken's grandmothers. She drives the party to the walled family estate and sets its house rules, including a ban on weapons inside any of the houses. She comes across as kind while planning brutal training, especially for Harley.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: Ken's biological grandmother, one of several grandmothers living at the Nagato estate. She is there when the party arrives and backs the plan to put everyone through demanding training.
characters.name: Sakura

characters.description: One of Ken's grandmothers, present in person when the party reaches the Nagato estate. She is a very big woman with the muscular build of a bodybuilder.
characters.name: Akari

characters.description: Ken's grandfather, who runs the Nagato estate together with Ken's grandmothers. He has a teasing streak and flirts with Crimson when she arrives. He and the grandmothers want the party prepared to fight off hostile adventurers.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: The elven royal who sent the censor to Ken. Crimson tells Ken that the princess does not truly have the class she claims, and Ken already knew it. He is meant to visit her after he reaches level 20, and he may share his Absorb skill with her.
characters.name: The elven princess

characters.description: One of Ken's grandmothers, separate from Yui, Sakura and Akari, and the one Ken regards as the warmest toward him. She is away when the party first reaches the estate. During Ken's test in the family dungeon, her banner flags keep monsters away from his spot on floor 5 for a time. When he finally comes out after about three days, she is there to greet him and tells him the flags stopped working on purpose.
characters.name: The banner grandmother

characters.description: Head of the Nagato family's retainers. He meets Ken as the clan starts hiring again for the first time in ten years, and he explains how the clan runs on tasks and points while still paying real wages. He also tells Ken that his mother disliked killing and thought the clan was no longer needed.
characters.name: Hiroshi

characters.description: Charlotte's gray-haired father, a guild leader. After Charlotte's sister Rachel phones her, he joins by video and agrees to come visit the Nagato estate.
characters.name: Marcus

characters.description: Charlotte's sister. She calls Charlotte while the party is at the Nagato estate and makes no secret of her hostility toward Ken.
characters.name: Rachel

characters.description: Hiroshi's daughter, a quiet damage dealer who is one of the young recruits Ken meets at the clan store. She tells him the clan only kills people who have earned it. When two of the recruits attack Ken in a hallway, Amy blocks Fred's blade and takes a deep wound.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: A level 7 tank who is one of the young recruits at the clan store, and Meg's brother. His family used to serve the clan and came back because Ken is Crimson's protege. He joins his sister in attacking Ken, Amy takes a deep wound blocking his blade, and he runs once Ken fights back.
characters.name: Fred

characters.description: A poison-casting Venomancer among the recruits at the clan store, and Fred's sister. She flirts with Ken, then corners him in a hallway and knocks out the two men with him using a bolt. Ken cancels her poison with Absorb, and she runs off with Fred, both shouting that a demon is on the attack.
characters.name: Meg

characters.description: The head of Halen. Crimson pays her to send everyone back to the academy from the family estate by portal.
characters.name: The headmistress

characters.description: A senior caster whom Ken and Dez notice in the dorm lobby after they return to Halen. They know her from the first party of the hostile student whose group Ken killed, where she appeared to be that student's subordinate or bodyguard. They suspect she is connected to the rival assassin clan and decide to raise it with Crimson.
characters.name: The upperclass caster

characters.description: A level 7 frost knight on Halen's Security Council. When a confrontation breaks out at the dorm entrance over Ken being there, she steps in and lets his group through.
characters.name: Penelope

characters.description: A paladin on Halen's Security Council with fiery hair. She objects to Ken entering the dorm and stands in his way at the door until Dez throws her.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A student in Crimson's class who runs her own party, which includes a healer. She attends Crimson's lessons alongside Ken's party.
characters.name: Kendra

characters.description: A student in Crimson's class who attends lessons alongside Kendra and Ken's party.
characters.name: Taylor

characters.description: The head of the United Guilds, a scarred summoner with a cluttered office full of secured files, who defers to Crimson. Together they give Ken a classified file on research into teleporting between dungeon safe zones. The file shows that the upperclass caster is assisting the research team on the tenth floor. The president is uneasy about her parent.
characters.name: The United Guilds president

characters.description: A thin, platinum-blonde student who leads a rival party in Crimson's class. Her arcane weaver class lets her shape mana into many different weaves. She challenges Ken's party to race to the floor-5 safe zone, and Dez quietly takes a side bet with her on undisclosed terms.
characters.name: The rival party leader

characters.description: A level 22 mage who runs a paid power-leveling guild from another city. Its customers pay to gain levels for health or job benefits. At the seventh-floor scorpion event he claims the eastern half for his guild with flags. He looks after his clients, stays neutral with the Halen students, and notices that Ken is Crimson's protege.
characters.name: Roger

characters.description: A rich online personality, only level 3, who pays for the power-leveling guild's level-20 clients at the scorpion event. She takes an epic wand from the loot and then gives it to Kendra in exchange for a future interview with Ken. She knows his family is a known assassin clan, and she has a crush on him.
characters.name: The influencer

characters.description: Charlotte's mother, a well-known and strict fighter whose class controls storms. At first she banned Charlotte from adventuring and only gave in reluctantly. Charlotte's view that healers only put off the inevitable came from her.
characters.name: Charlotte's mother

characters.description: A level-45 incubus demon lord sealed inside Ken. He visits Ken in a dream, swelling until the chains of the seal strain, and asks for magazines, offering power and training in exchange. He says he gave Ken the Charm skill and some stats, and Ken suspects he is holding back how much power he still has.
characters.name: Snoo

characters.description: Penelope's cousin, a blue-haired girl who flirts with Harley.
characters.name: Meredith

characters.description: A scientist in Halen's dungeon research labs with frizzy black hair. She has built a synthetic skill book that opens portals between tenth-floor safe zones, but learning it wiped the stats of the prison volunteers who tried. She is an idealist who does not want the technology used for war, and she plans a full demonstration at the end-of-year celebration. Her CID is fused into a band that the United Guilds tracks.
characters.name: Dr. Finley

characters.description: A student mage with black hair and blue eyes who helps in Dr. Finley's lab on weekends by filling its batteries with mana. Ken recognizes her as the upperclass caster who supported the hostile student and the anti-elf front. She says the portal technology could favor the strong and calls the prison volunteers expendable. Ken suspects she belongs to the rival assassin clan.
characters.name: Dr. Finley's lab assistant

characters.description: Helen's red-haired mother, a powerful adventurer known as the Harem Queen. She is one of the elite parents who gather at the dungeon entrance for Dr. Finley's end-of-year portal demonstration.
characters.name: Helen's mother

characters.description: A ten-foot, six-armed female Naga whose red scales turn blue toward her tail. She is the first creature through Dr. Finley's portal, and her shockwave levels nearby buildings. She can cast six spells at once and heal herself, and she kills a level 53 fighter of the White Tigers guild in close combat before Crimson attacks her and drives her back from the portal.
characters.name: The six-armed Naga

characters.description: A masked fighter sent by the rival assassin clan as reinforcement when Ken's party corners the lab assistant at the floor-6 exit. He is a little higher in level than Ken and has a venomous, viper-like striking ability. He puts a knife to Charlotte and cuts her throat. Ken and Fayeth defeat him, and Fayeth stabs him to death.
characters.name: The masked assassin

characters.description: Narrator and head of the Nagato clan, a human student adventurer at level 13. During the Naga incident he absorbed a synthetic portal spellbook and used it to shut the portal, but the Portal skill it gave him now shows as restricted. He turns down the harem queen's offer and agrees to spend the summer in the elven world, drawing the people who want his ability away from home while Crimson tries to find her way back.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: An elf tank who fights with shield and spear, and Ken's bonded partner. She is carried out of the dungeon with him after the Naga incident and goes with Ken, Amy and the royal censor to the elven world for the summer.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: Ken's instructor, a ferocious fighter whose Limit Break state is hard for her to rein in. During the Naga incident she went through a portal into Naga territory, and she is stranded there as the book opens. Part of Ken's reason for leaving Earth for the summer is to buy her time to return.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: A silver-haired elf with a ponytail who serves as a royal censor and is one of the strongest fighters on the scene. She carries Ken and Fayeth out of the dungeon, beats the harem queen in a duel, and takes on the job of escorting and protecting Ken during his summer in the elven world.
characters.name: The royal censor

characters.description: Helen's mother, a red-haired fighter who carries a sword wreathed in blue flame. She chases Ken out of the dungeon and offers him the top place in her harem because of the portal spellbook he absorbed. When he says no, she loses a duel to the royal censor and pulls back, insisting he will come to her in the end. She is later allowed to supervise Helen.
characters.name: The harem queen

characters.description: A member of Ken's circle and the harem queen's daughter. To avoid being taken home by her mother, she adopts a cover story suggested by Dez, publicly declaring that she loves Ken and writes an online smut serial about him. The ploy lets her stay: she joins the Silverfangs, with her mother permitted to oversee her.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A masked, white-haired member of the Nagato clan, assigned to Ken as an ally by one of his grandmothers. She joins Ken, Fayeth and the royal censor on the journey to the elven world and stays close to him as his attendant.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: One of Ken's grandmothers, a healer able to move as mist. She travels with the group for the first stretch of the descent toward the elven world before turning back.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: A druid healer among Ken's fellow students. When the families arrange intensive summer training at the Nagato estate, aiming to push the students to level 20 before their second year, Charlotte asks to take part and her mother agrees. She remains on Earth while Ken leaves for the elven world.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: Charlotte's mother, a mage who commands storms. She is present at the dungeon exit after the Naga incident and gives her consent for Charlotte to join the accelerated summer training the families organize at the Nagato estate.
characters.name: Charlotte's mother

characters.description: A half-demon member of Ken's group whose family is responsible for the demon sealed inside him. After the Naga incident her father leads the push to fast-track the students' growth over the summer, and she is the one who proposes Helen's cover story so Helen can stay rather than go home with her mother.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: A white-haired woman of a cat-eared tribal race, marked with blue tiger stripes, whom Ken meets in the floor 45 safe zone. A shaman traveling with a protective leopard-spotted guard, she sits down with Ken uninvited, questions him, and is taken with his scent, yet will not explain how her people make use of the dungeon.
characters.name: The cat-people shaman

characters.description: The emperor's red-haired, blue-eyed daughter, an isolated young elf with few if any friends. She is a distant cousin and childhood friend of Fayeth. She hopes to gain Ken's Absorb ability and hosts him and Fayeth as if they were family.
characters.name: The elf princess

characters.description: A royal censor ranked just below the head of the princess's guard. Watching Ken train in the palace gym, she studies his Nagato sword style and correctly guesses that assassins taught him. She is fiercely protective of the princess and had bowed to Ken after the welcome dinner.
characters.name: The second-ranking censor

characters.description: Fayeth's mother, a warm and very outspoken elf whose husband works as an ambassador in another world. On meeting Ken she teases him with blunt questions and is alarmed to hear that Crimson is his teacher, given the rumors about Crimson, but she quickly declares that she is adopting him as a son and plans to cook him dinner.
characters.name: Fayeth's mother

characters.description: Ruler of the elves and the princess's father. He presented his daughter to the public as a prophesied hero. He has turned floors 61 to 65 of the dungeon into sealed minefields because the route to the Naga lies beneath them, a move that has angered elite elves, and there is talk that he may abdicate in her favor.
characters.name: The emperor

characters.description: One of the princess's royal censors. On the party's first dive through the royal family's private entrance, she uses a teleport-like ability to move everyone from the grassland of the first floor to a red-rock zone containing an orc village, where the princess shows Ken how she really fights.
characters.name: The teleporting censor

characters.description: The arrogant heir of a powerful ducal house, strong enough to stand up to the royal censor. He barges into the princess's training zone with high-level companions, demands a spar, sneers at Ken as a mere human, and claims the princess will soon be engaged to him. She denies it and he storms off. His house once governed three great trees, lost two in a tax scandal, and has since won one back.
characters.name: The younger duke

characters.description: Father of the younger duke, holding the same ducal title. Together they lead a large bloc of dukes and top adventurers opposed to the emperor, whose main demand is that the closed upper dungeon floors be reopened. A marriage between his son and the princess would expose her false class.
characters.name: The elder duke

characters.description: An older elf with a mustache who directs a wave of crushing killing intent toward the princess's group at the palace ballroom event. Ken steps in front of her and mostly withstands it, though he can tell the man is far beyond his own strength.
characters.name: The mustached elf

characters.description: A noble elf at the palace event who belittles Ken as the princess's pet. After Ken shows her how much metal humans have and casually throw away on Earth, she changes course and asks for a meeting to discuss trade.
characters.name: The duchess

characters.description: The princess's mother, who no longer stands at the emperor's side and has withdrawn from politics because she disapproves of his course. She is described as gentler than her husband, and Ken is promised an introduction to her.
characters.name: The princess's mother

characters.description: Head of an elven adventuring party led by a hooded archer that ambushes Ken's group on the sixth floor. He offers to sell the disguised princess and Fayeth in a duke's new city and turns out to be part of a ring trafficking drugged, declawed cat-people. Cruel but loyal to his own crew, he is a little more skilled in combat than Ken.
characters.name: The slaver leader

characters.description: The owner of a brothel in a neon-lit vice district hidden under the roots of a duke's city. Far stronger than anyone in Ken's party, she buys the disguised princess for a large sum in crystals. Flirtatious and businesslike, she boasts that she will sell anything, information included, and she quickly suspects the princess is more than a lookalike.
characters.name: The brothel madam

characters.description: A level 30 cat-person held captive and forced to work in the hidden vice district. Ken books time with her and proves his connection to the cat-people shaman with clothing that carries the shaman's scent. She agrees to help, and Ken promises that she and the other captives will be sent home.
characters.name: The captive cat-woman

characters.description: A heavyset elf who runs a bar in the hidden district and wields ember magic, stronger than Ken. He is allied with the duke's family and schemes to take over the madam's position. When Ken attacks him he grows more powerful amid the flames, sets his own bar on fire, and pursues Ken after he escapes.
characters.name: The ember mage

characters.description: A tall, thin elf armed with crescent blades who works under the ember mage. Ken overhears the two discussing a book of letters tying the duke to the trafficking, and the lanky elf carries the book off to a safe house.
characters.name: The lanky elf

characters.description: A huge white Naga matriarch commanding an army in a Naga safe zone. When Crimson cuts through dozens of her soldiers, the matriarch strikes her hard with her tail, and Crimson chooses to flee rather than face her directly.
characters.name: The white Naga matriarch

characters.description: A royal censor who fights on the front line and is the strongest brawler among the princess's guards. Her power grows with contracts and money, and the class she advertises is not her real one. She travels with the party as they escort the freed cat-people down through the dungeon.
characters.name: The merchant censor

characters.description: An older cat-person woman with silver in her hair who leads the group waiting in the floor 40 safe zone. She thanks Ken and the elves for returning the freed captives, invites the shaman to lead a ritual in their honor, and blesses Ken as someone with great potential.
characters.name: The cat-people elder

characters.description: The head of the UG, who is visibly afraid of Crimson and gives way to her. After she gets a new CID, the president brings her up to date on Ken closing the portal, the greed his ability stirred up, and his departure for the elven world, and asks her not to kill the harem queen.
characters.name: The UG president

characters.description: A royal censor able to change her face. During the plan to slip into the seized palace she takes on the mustached elf's appearance to help the infiltrators, then stays behind to guard the entrance.
characters.name: The shapeshifting censor

recaps.ending: The coup is over and the house behind it is finished: the younger duke dies at the wedding, and his father, crippled there, is beheaded in the throne room, while the rebels' supporters are sent to fight the Naga. The princess governs as acting regent and is publicly bound to Ken, sharing Absorb and Spell Mirror with him through their harmony; her own claimed hero class still rests on borrowed effects. She promises to join Ken on Earth once her father's war is won. The emperor, now holding the front until floor 65 is retaken, grudgingly values ties with humans but still seems to dislike the match. A metal supply contract of at least a million metric tons links the Nagato clan to a blue-haired duchess, with the head censor as liaison. The captive empress mentioned during the coup is not accounted for. Crimson is back as Ken's trainer and apparent partner, with partial command over Limit Break that Ken can switch off by voice. Ken, stronger and carrying Hydra and Blessing of the Dungeon, can use Portal inside the dungeon but still cannot open portals, and others continue to covet the ability. He and Fayeth head home for their second year, where Dez (level 25), Charlotte (level 21) and Helen wait at the Nagato estate. The harem queen remains alive, punished and interested in Ken, and the cat-people shaman is among several other suitors. A human faction working with the Naga, a rival clan, his parents' betrayal and the sealed demon all remain open.
recaps.in_short: With Crimson lost in Naga territory and powerful adventurers chasing his new portal power, Ken spends the summer in the elven world under a royal censor's protection, bringing Fayeth and Amy, while his friends train at the Nagato estate. The elf princess, whose hero class is a lie staged by her father, courts him openly, and Ken accepts her into his household alongside Fayeth despite the emperor's hostility. Hunting evidence against a scheming ducal house, Ken goes undercover among slavers, kills two of the house's agents, turns a fugitive former censor into a witness, and frees captive cat-people; the duke is condemned and the princess publicly chooses Ken. Crimson fights her way out of the Naga floors, while the cat-people shaman's ritual unlocks Ken's Portal inside the dungeon. The ducal house then seizes the palace while the emperor is at the Naga front. Ken kills the younger duke in an infiltration, but the group is captured and the princess is to be forced into marriage. Crimson arrives, the wedding is turned into a rout, the usurper is executed, and the princess pledges herself to Ken as acting regent. Crimson destroys a Naga army and its white matriarch, Ken learns he can command her Limit Break to stop, and he leaves with Fayeth for his second school year.

recaps.text: Previously: Ken Nagato is a student adventurer and head of the Nagato clan, whose grandparents are assassins who keep him sharp with surprise attacks. He trains under Crimson, an immensely powerful instructor whose berserk Limit Break state is difficult for her to control. His circle includes his elf partner Fayeth, the druid healer Charlotte, the half-demon Dez, and Helen. Dez's family sealed a level 45 demon inside Ken, which gave him a secondary Demon Lord class. The previous book ended with the Naga incident: a portal opened toward Naga territory, Crimson went through it while deep in Limit Break and vanished, and Ken absorbed a synthetic portal spellbook and used its power to close the gateway. That feat has made his new ability something strong adventurers want for themselves. Several older matters also remain unsettled, including a rival clan, his parents' betrayal, and the demon sealed within him.

So far this book: An elven royal censor carries Ken and Fayeth out of the dungeon after the Naga incident. Helen's mother, the harem queen, pursues them and offers Ken the head place in her harem; he refuses, the censor defeats her in a duel, and she backs off for now. Ken's Portal skill is marked restricted, and Crimson is stranded among the Naga. To pull pursuers away and give Crimson time, Ken decides to spend the summer in the elven world with the censor, Fayeth and Amy, a masked Nagato clan member who insists she is his butler. Back home, the families plan intensive training at the Nagato estate aimed at level 20 before second year. Charlotte joins, Dez takes on demon blood to grow her class, and Helen stays by pretending to love Ken and write a smut serial about him, joining the Silverfangs.

The censor power-levels the party on the descent, and Ken's grandmother Yui travels with them as far as floor 50. In the floor 45 safe zone a cat-people shaman takes an interest in Ken, sleeps beside him, guesses his tie to Crimson, and leaves after Amy trades his dirty clothes; the skill book she offered teaches Amy a stealth skill.

In the elven capital Ken meets the princess, Fayeth's cousin and old friend. Her hero class is a fiction staged by her father, the emperor; she is actually an Eidolon Priest, and she wants Ken's Absorb ability, which would require genuine soul harmony. She flirts openly; Ken insists he will judge her by her actions, while Fayeth encourages him to let her in. The emperor has sealed floors 61 to 65 against the Naga, angering the elite, and may abdicate. Fayeth's mother meets Ken and adopts him as a son.

So far this book: Through the royal family's private dungeon entrance, the princess shows her true fighting style, taking on monster forms such as a minotaur and a hydra that replace her own abilities. The younger duke, heir of a house that once ruled three great trees, interrupts with high-level allies, insults Ken, and claims the princess will marry him; she refuses. Fayeth's mother learns that the princess intends to present Ken as the human holder of the revered elven class and approves of the princess joining his household. She also explains the politics: several dukes, led by the younger duke and his father, have formed a bloc against the emperor and want the upper floors reopened. Ken realizes a marriage into that house would expose the princess's false class.

In the royal library the princess helps Ken choose a dark area-damage skill that spreads blades in a wide arc, gives him the book, and kisses him; he agrees to try for a shared household, and Fayeth approves. Meanwhile Crimson surfaces after about a week of nonstop Limit Break on a deep Naga floor, her CID broken, holding herself together by thinking of Ken.

At a palace ball the princess presents Ken to the dukes. He turns a duchess's insult into interest in a metal trade, plans to supply iron through the Silverfangs, and shields the princess from a mustached elf ranked eighth among elven adventurers. The emperor then forbids the match, calls Ken merely the key to his daughter's cage, says Crimson will probably not return, and predicts elves may one day conquer humans, though he asks Ken to keep her safe. Shaken, Ken grows wary of the princess's motives. The head censor, who turns out to be the emperor's cousin and the princess's relative, advises her to keep courting Ken and reveal her politics gradually.

So far this book: A noble loyal to the duke seals the palace dungeon stairway as a protest. Ken is level 19, his CID cut off from home servers, and the princess explains that Absorb lets harmonized partners share class skills, which are lost if the harmony breaks. Ken tells her he believes she is not using him. Disguised as a servant, the princess enters the public dungeon with Ken, Fayeth and Amy; Ken buys her a blue crystal ring. On floor 6 an elven party ambushes them, offering to sell the servants in the duke's new city, and Ken learns they traffic drugged, declawed cat-people. The princess has secretly hired the Nagato clan to find proof linking the duke to the kidnapping of a noblewoman, so Ken plays along and sells her.

In a hidden vice district under the city a powerful madam buys the princess. A captive cat-woman agrees to help Ken. He kills the slaver leader, overhears an ember-mage bar owner and a lanky elf discussing a book of incriminating letters, fights the mage, and later kills him in a burning building. The madam confronts Ken, sees his Absorb, and works out that the princess's class is false.

The royal censor arrives. The madam proves to be a former royal censor wanted for taking the duke's bribes; she sells the princess back, accepts a five-year contract with her bounty lifted, agrees to testify, and goes with Ken to the safe house, where she kills the lanky elf. Ken's earnings are surrendered in the deal. The district is dismantled, the duke's family is placed under house arrest, and fifteen cat-people are sheltered at the palace. At the trial Ken's truthful testimony holds up, the duke is condemned to death, and the princess tells the jailed younger duke that Ken is the man she will marry.

So far this book: Crimson wakes among Naga corpses, her armor ruined and CID smashed, and dresses in Naga gear. Her Eyes of Wisdom finally reveal a stairway up. A white matriarch's tail blow convinces her to flee, and she picks her way across trapped floors into elf territory and out to a UG branch with Italian-speaking staff, where she demands a new CID.

About a month after the incident, Ken learns in training that Portal works on the elven surface but collapses him from mana drain. Eleven censors escort Ken, the princess, Fayeth, Amy and the fifteen freed cat-people down the royal entrance; the princess invites Ken to share her tent. On floor 40 the cat-people reclaim their kin. Their shaman says the dungeon, which they worship as the Great One, has marked Ken, and her ritual gives him a dagger tattoo showing that Portal now works inside the dungeon at a high mana cost. He also gains Blessing of the Dungeon, and he uses Absorb on the princess.

The UG president tells Crimson that Ken closed the portal and went to the elves, that most of her students are at the Nagato estate, and asks her not to kill the harem queen. A floor 60 report says Crimson passed through and that white Naga have broken through trapped floors. Returning, the party is ambushed at the palace exit by the mustached elf, who announces the duke now holds the throne while the emperor is away; the merchant censor smashes him into the ceiling.

At the estate Crimson finds Charlotte at level 21 and Dez more demonic, then beats and chains the harem queen, demanding skill books for Ken's partners. Ken proposes infiltrating the seized palace; the princess insists on coming, and a shapeshifting censor helps them in.

So far this book: Inside the royal quarters the princess charms a captive duke into revealing that the rebels hold the empress prisoner, then kills him. Ken finds the younger duke in the princess's bed and kills him using Absorb, Spell Mirror and Dark Strike, but the noise brings guards, and the whole group, censors included, is captured. The younger duke's father takes the throne, has healers revive his son, and orders the princess married to him at dawn. One censor who had seemed bought by the rebels appears to defect. That night the princess fights the younger duke off twice with her monster forms.

Crimson reaches Ken's cell, heals him, and they plan to wreck the wedding. She blasts the guards and frees the head censor, and the supposedly bought censor, loyal all along under a contract clause, breaks the usurper's legs. Ken and the princess fight together and kill the younger duke. The princess declares the coup treason and publicly pledges herself to Ken, with Fayeth at their side. As acting regent she has the usurper beheaded and sends his backers to the Naga front, and she brokers a metal deal of at least a million metric tons between a duchess and the Nagato clan. Crimson shows her greatly increased stats and approves of the princess; the princess's mother, wary of the rushed marriage, accepts Ken once he says the emperor asked him to protect her.

Crimson drills Ken hard, and he takes Hydra from the princess. At floor 63 a Naga army led by a white matriarch emerges; at Ken's request Crimson enters a controlled Limit Break, annihilates it, kills the matriarch, and calms down on her own. The emperor thanks them grudgingly and will hold the front until floor 65 is retaken. Ken finds he can order Crimson's Limit Break off. The princess promises to follow after the war, and Ken and Fayeth leave for their second school year.
